result.rationale: The diff shows `blacklistedGuestEmails` built via `.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`, but `uniqueGuests` filters with `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` using the raw, non-lowercased guest string. A mixed-case guest email therefore bypasses a lowercase blacklisted entry. The mechanism is directly verifiable in the diff.
